deep_dive.title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
deep_dive.abstract: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset. Our model achieves a DSC of 0.90812 (threshold of 0.5) with its compact architecture of 430,052 parameters and 0.549 Giga Multiply-Accumulate operations (GMAC), making it up to 10 times faster, requires 79 times less GMAC than UNet, and has 22 times fewer parameters than SegNet. These characteristics make it well-suited for deployment in clinical settings where computational resources are limited and decrease the cost of utilizing such a system. Additionally, the explainable AI technique of Grad-CAM is used to provide visual interpretability of the model's predictions and to identify regions where segmentation performance requires improvement.

deep_dive.llm_tldr_en: Proposes a lightweight ENet-based model with UNet skip connections and CBAM attention for energy-efficient lung tumor segmentation supporting early detection and radiotherapy treatment planning.
deep_dive.llm_tldr_cn: 肺癌肿瘤分割对早期发现和治疗计划至关重要，但先进深度模型每次前向计算量巨大、推理慢，限制临床部署。本文提出轻量节能模型，以ENet为主干实现实时推理，引入UNet式跳跃连接复用特征，并加入轻量CBAM注意力模块提升特征表达。方法在保持分割精度的同时显著降低计算开销。该工作为肺肿瘤靶区自动分割的临床落地提供高效方案，与放疗靶区勾画需求高度相关。
